model.name: HIPAA Security Rule (starter)
model.documentation: The HIPAA Security Rule, 45 CFR Part 164 Subpart C: the administrative, physical and technical safeguards of sections 164.308, 164.310 and 164.312 and the organizational, policy and documentation requirements of sections 164.314 and 164.316. Every standard is broken into its implementation specifications, each marked required or addressable: a required specification must be implemented; an addressable one must be implemented where reasonable and appropriate, or the alternative and the reasons documented. Each standard is realized by an example control, and the technical controls are applied to the example clinic's systems that hold electronic protected health information (ePHI), with a business associate agreement behind every business associate. Summaries are paraphrased; the Code of Federal Regulations is the reference. This model is a structuring aid, not legal advice.

element.name: HIPAA Security Rule, 45 CFR Part 164 Subpart C
element.documentation: Applies to covered entities (health plans, health care clearinghouses and health care providers that transmit health information electronically) and their business associates.

element.name: Confidentiality, integrity and availability of ePHI
element.documentation: Section 164.306(a): protect all ePHI created, received, maintained or transmitted against reasonably anticipated threats, hazards and impermissible uses or disclosures.

view.name: Security Rule safeguards and standards
view.documentation: The five sections of Subpart C with the standards each one sets. The implementation specifications behind every standard are in the next two views.

view.name: Administrative safeguards
view.documentation: Section 164.308: each standard with its implementation specifications, marked required or addressable, and the control that realizes it. For an addressable specification, record what was decided and why.

view.name: Physical, technical and organizational safeguards
view.documentation: Sections 164.310, 164.312, 164.314 and 164.316: each standard with its implementation specifications, marked required or addressable, and the control that realizes it. The group health plan standard has no control because it does not apply to the example clinic; record that reason.

view.name: Systems holding ePHI and business associates
view.documentation: The technical controls applied to each system that holds ePHI, and the business associate agreement behind every system a business associate runs. A system holding ePHI without the controls drawn to it, or an associate without a signed agreement, is a finding.
